g.title: WebAgentArchitecture
g.text: WebAgent: policy-bound planning, browser execution, and auditable evidence

g.title: planner
g.text: API auto ladder: native tools -> JSON Schema -> prompt JSON

g.title: browser
g.text: stability wait + URL + DOM snapshot + adaptive screenshot

g.title: executor
g.text: validate -> execution policy -> risk policy -> timeout -> dispatch

g.title: checkpoint
g.text: committed next step + bounded recovery state

g.title: trace
g.text: planner attempts + browser state + ToolCall + ToolResult + events

g.title: exposure
g.text: one allowed set for planner and executor

g.title: documents
g.text: local profile -> ordered cloud providers -> quality gate
first passing result wins; PyMuPDF only after all cloud providers fail

g.title: result
g.text: attachments + observable evidence + independent evaluation boundary
